messages:
priya: Noticed a reconciliation alert: ~dozen users were deprovisioned then immediately recreated without the `mfa_required` role after a scheduled IdP cert rotation overnight.

maria: I pulled the provisioner logs and saw signature verification failures around the rotation window. Sample redacted log: 
```
WARN provisioner: verify_assertion failed: signature_invalid (kid not found)
ERROR provisioner: role_assertion_apply skipped for user=jdoe@example.com
```

sam: Sounds like the IdP rotated keys but our metadata refresh lagged. KMS decrypt of blobs looks fine so this is signature/KID lookup, not envelope context.

sec-oncall: Mitigation: (1) queue metadata refresh and re-run pending assertion processing, (2) enable short-term reconciler to mark affected users for manual review and block privilege escalation until verification completes, (3) collect audit logs and prepare a low-sev customer note if >50 users.

provision-bot: automation: queued metadata refresh job md-20260510-1, and reconciliation job rec-20260510-1.

maria: Metadata fetch completed; new JWKS contains rotated KID. Reprocessing assertions: 12 users reconciled, MFA role reapplied. No customer reports.

priya: Postmortem action items: add an IdP-rotate preflight that (a) polls JWKS before rotation cutover, (b) keeps previous KID cached for 24h, and (c) triggers an immediate metadata refresh webhook.

sam: I'll add metric sso.verify.failure{k="kid_missing"} and a dashboard alert for spikes during rotations. Also PR to make reprocessor idempotent.

sec-oncall: Good. Also add runbook step to check audit-log continuity and ensure no gap in signed assertions. Closing after postmortem ticket created.
